BLOCKING CORRECTION — surrey-panjabi-gallery-tour-july-30.mdx:64 leaks pipeline/reviewer voice into reader-facing prose.

Line 64: "- **Artistic practice**: The source says Kaur's talk connects illustration, poetry, music, and design."

"The source says" appears exactly once across the entire corpus — this line. A grep of content/ and all release candidates returns no other instance; published things-to-do articles use "The City says" (5), "The listing says" (3), "The event page says" (1). Worse, the list is already introduced two lines above by "The event page says Kaur will speak about:", so the bullet re-attributes the same page a second time inside its own lead-in. To a reader this parses as an unedited drafting artifact, not house voice. The underlying claim is fine — the source's "Through illustration, poetry, music, and design, Kaur will speak about... sharing her artistic practice" supports it — so this is purely a copy fix.

Suggested fix: "- **Artistic practice**: Her talk connects illustration, poetry, music, and design."

WORTH FIXING IN THE SAME PASS (non-blocking):
Line 65 — "**Exhibition context**: The tour focuses on Kaur's exhibition, *If Gardens Could Dream*." breaks the "Kaur will speak about:" frame (this describes the tour's subject, not a topic of her remarks) and restates line 57 verbatim in substance. Title/meta fit, structure, and reader usefulness are otherwise sound: the 48-character title is accurate on all four of its claims (free, Panjabi, Thursday, Surrey), the description is within length and non-duplicative of the subtitle, headings run in a logical confirmed → program → plan order, and time/address/price/registration land in the first screen.

Fix line 64 and this is ready for publication.
